description: Search recall campaigns by vehicle or campaign number. Use for specific recall lookups, recall history for a vehicle, or looking up a known campaign number.

campaignNumber.description: NHTSA campaign number (e.g., "20V682000"). When provided, returns the campaign detail plus every vehicle it covers. Mutually exclusive with make/model/modelYear.

dateRange.description: Filter recalls by received date. Applied locally since the API lacks native date filtering.

after.description: Only recalls received after this date (ISO 8601, e.g., "2025-01-01").

before.description: Only recalls received before this date (ISO 8601, e.g., "2026-01-01").

make.description: Vehicle manufacturer. Required with model and modelYear when not using campaignNumber.

model.description: Vehicle model. Required with make and modelYear.

modelYear.description: Model year, a whole number. Required with make and model.

name: nhtsa_search_recalls

effectiveQuery.description: The search key used: campaign number, or "make model modelYear" for vehicle queries.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `mode_conflict`: Both campaignNumber and vehicle params were provided. `missing_required_combo`: Neither campaignNumber nor a complete vehicle triple was supplied. `campaign_not_found`: The campaignNumber did not match any NHTSA recall. `invalid_date`: A dateRange bound could not be parsed as a date. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when no recalls are found — e.g. how to verify make/model/year spelling.

affectedVehicles.description: Every distinct make/model the campaign covers (campaign queries). Equipment and tire campaigns name the part here — make is the brand, model is the part — and carry no model year.

items.description: One vehicle covered by the campaign

investigationId.description: ODI investigation that preceded this campaign, when NHTSA links one (campaign queries) — pass it as nhtsaId to nhtsa_search_investigations for the full record.

overTheAirUpdate.description: OTA update availability when provided by NHTSA

parkIt.description: Do-not-drive advisory when provided by NHTSA

parkOutSide.description: Park-outside advisory when provided by NHTSA

title: Nhtsa Search Recalls
